questions.question: Explain how the Working Memory Model accounts for dual-task performance better than the Multi-Store Model

points.text: MSM: single STM store -> two verbal tasks interfere. WMM: separate stores (PL for verbal, VSSP for visual) -> can do verbal + visual simultaneously. Evidence: Baddeley (verbal reasoning + tracking). PL overload impairs both if both verbal
